description: Known benign patterns written by analysts in plain language (doc 6.4). Added by pull request only, reviewed by a second owner (R7). `applies_to` is optional and filters in code which descriptions are sent: `agents` (Wazuh agent names) and `rule_ids`; a pattern without it is sent with every alert.
